# celestial object type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:celestialObjectType`](gmeow-celestialObjectType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/celestialObjectType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The kind(s) of a celestial location (one or more [`gmeow:CelestialObjectType`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialObjectType.md) individuals). Non-functional: multi-source classifications may differ (e.g. a source classified as both 'star' and 'variable star') and must coexist as evidence.
